facts.text: John mentions that having a ball to remind him of the bond and support from his teammates is comforting and motivates him to stay strong and give it his all.

evidence.quote: Having something like this ball to remind me of the bond and support from my teammates is really comforting. It's a nice reminder of why I started playing basketball and my journey. It motivates me to stay strong and give it my all.

facts.text: John states that having supportive people around is like having a cheer team that helps him through tough times.

evidence.quote: It's really motivating to have something that reminds you of why you started, and having supportive people around is like having a cheer team that helps you through tough times.

facts.text: John expresses that having support encourages him to give it his all and never give up, describing it as an awesome feeling.

evidence.quote: Having that support really encourages me to give it my all and never give up. It's an awesome feeling!

facts.text: Tim acknowledges the power of people's strength coming from each other and says goodbye.

evidence.quote: It's awesome how much strength people can get from each other. Bye!
